observations: Root mandatory manifests and typed effective directives are implemented and exact-head published.
External observation activities and receipts remain absent, so facts known by the outer executor still cannot become O decision authority through a defined path.
fragment.purpose: Select the first authoritative external observation-receipt vertical slice after typed directive compilation.

observations: The next architecture dependency is an O-requested observation receipt: extending manifests or effect binding first would propagate outer-session facts without a durable ingestion boundary.
A single GitHub public-read vertical slice is small enough to falsify request binding, replay, staleness, and omission without prematurely designing every provider schema.
local_learn.reason: The typed directive compiler closed internal user-authority ambiguity; the highest-information next unit is to test whether an external fact can become O authority only through a frozen request and verified receipt.

result.claim_boundary: A verified GitHub observation path is internal context-control infrastructure plus one connected-source integration record. It is not independent production capability, useful behavioral improvement, AGI, or completion of the user's objective.
evidence_needed: a frozen O observation request with stable request id/digest, source kind and locator, selected public fields, freshness/invalidation policy, executor/model binding, and no secrets

an immutable receipt cross-bound to the request digest and exact GitHub repository/ref/file or commit identity, with observed result digest, source version, observation time, status, and explicit unknown/error fields

mechanical verification that rejects an unsolicited outer fact, unknown request, request/receipt identity mismatch, result tampering, duplicate conflicting receipt, stale receipt, and source version mismatch
an append-only context event or observation ledger entry derived from the verified receipt without copying the full raw GitHub payload
a later Root manifest source whose projection and source clock are derived from that verified ledger entry and whose identity changes only at the next semantic boundary
one real connected-GitHub read performed from a persisted request and returned as a receipt, with exact remote readback or compare evidence separated from internal simulation
protected tests proving a frozen pending request remains unchanged and untracked outer-session knowledge cannot affect O judgment
expected_outputs: a small generic observation request/receipt module and one GitHub public-read schema
durable request, receipt, and minimal ledger records for one actual GitHub observation
Context Kernel integration for the verified observation projection at a subsequent Root boundary
focused fail-closed and replay tests, compileall, repository JSON validation, work-verify, exact diff review, isolated exact-head CI, merge, and readback

negative evidence stating that a connector receipt is operator-path evidence unless independently attested and that one observation source does not establish complete context control or behavioral improvement
failure_conditions: the outer executor can insert a fact without a prior O request
request, executor, model, source locator, selected fields, or source version can change without invalidating the receipt
a stale or contradictory receipt silently enters a new manifest
the integration rewrites an already frozen request
the receipt copies secrets or an unbounded raw response
the implementation labels GitHub readback or CI as independent behavioral or AGI evidence
result.goal: Implement the first O-owned external observation activity and immutable receipt path for one GitHub source, then prove that only a request-bound, mechanically verified receipt can enter a later DecisionContextManifest while untracked outer-session facts and stale or mismatched receipts fail closed.
inputs: src/continual/context_kernel.py source registry, clocks, and immutable Root manifest

src/continual/work_effects.py and work_effect_dispatch.py request/receipt/idempotency patterns without treating a read as an effect
the connected GitHub source for bachikoljunior-blip/O and exact main identity after PR 277
result.parent_continuation: After Execute, evaluate request-to-receipt binding, tamper/staleness fail-closure, actual connected-source evidence, replay, and next-boundary manifest invalidation; consolidate and learn. If it passes, proceed to multi-component manifests and dispatch-time critical-source revocation before claiming context control or useful behavioral improvement.
result.rollback: Remove the observation source from mandatory manifests and keep the request/receipt records as negative evidence if receipts cannot be cross-bound, bounded, replayed, and freshness-checked without creating another authority or weakening current Root fail-closure.
